Lead Charizard and Venusaur to immediately control weather with Mega Charizard Y's Drought. In Sun, Venusaur gains Chlorophyll speed (264 Spe), threatening fast Life Orb Sun-boosted Weather Ball and Earth Power against Archaludon/Aegislash. Charizard supplies heavy spread pressure with Sun Heat Wave and Solar Beam. Dragapult and Skeledirge in the back provide fast cleaning and defensive stability against physical attackers like Medicham.

reflections.summary: Lost because the preview (Pelipper/Archaludon/Aegislash/Mega Medicham) was mismatched to the opponent’s sun + Dragapult core: Pelipper’s rain was negated by Drought and it died to Thunderbolt; Archaludon collapsed to spread damage; Aegislash entered into sun-boosted Heat Wave and Shadow Ball; Mega Medicham was isolated and KO’d by Dragapult Shadow Ball despite Protect. Medicham was the right Mega holder, but the four lacked sun resilience and a Dragapult/Sash answer.
reflections.adjustment: For game 3, drop Pelipper and Archaludon; bring sun-tolerant partners and a priority/multi-hit Sash-breaker for Dragapult. Keep Medichamite on Medicham but pair it with redirect/protection, not rain. Never switch Aegislash into active Charizard-Y; prioritize breaking Dragapult’s Focus Sash on entry, and use Medicham Protect only after the Sash is broken or Dragapult is forced out.
reflections.notebook: Durable opponent core: Mega Charizard-Y (Drought, Modest, Heat Wave spread, Protect) + Dragapult (Infiltrator, Focus Sash, Shadow Ball/Draco Meteor/Thunderbolt/Protect, Timid, outspeeds Mega Medicham). Reserves: Garganacl (Wide Guard, Recover, Salt Cure, Leftovers, Careful), Skeledirge (Unaware, Slack Off, Shadow Ball, Earth Power, Sitrus), Clefable (Unaware, Follow Me, Helping Hand, Protect, Babiri). Venusaur (Chlorophyll, Life Orb, Earth Power/Weather Ball) was present but fainted. Strategic facts: Sun nullifies rain; Dragapult Sash requires immediate chip/priority to disable; Unaware users nullify Medicham’s boosts; Wide Guard blocks spread. Future plans: No rain setters vs this drought core. Lead Mega Medicham with a protect/redirect partner. Break Dragapult Sash before it fires. Avoid Aegislash entry vs sun Heat Wave. Use Fake Out on Charizard only when Dragapult is not threatening an immediate Shadow Ball.

reflections.summary: Immediate Mega Evolution of Charizard-Y on Turn 1 wrested weather control away from Pelipper's Drizzle, enabling Sun-boosted Weather Ball and Heat Wave to dismantle Archaludon and Pelipper early while Dragapult swept the remaining low-health targets.
reflections.adjustment: Leading Charizard-Y alongside Venusaur against rain cores guarantees early weather dominance and immediate Chlorophyll speed control, which completely shuts down opposing tempo.
reflections.notebook: Opponent roster & sets confirmed: Archaludon (Sturdy, Leftovers; Flash Cannon, Dragon Tail, Stealth Rock), Pelipper (Drizzle, Damp Rock; Hurricane, Rain Dance), Aegislash (Life Orb; Shadow Ball, Shadow Sneak), Mega Medicham (Jolly; Fake Out, Close Combat, Psycho Cut). Key takeaway: Mega Charizard Y's Drought combined with Chlorophyll Venusaur invalidates Pelipper rain compositions.
